source: Four user-supplied photographs of the wall-count coupons; no direct observation during deposition.
observations: Raised gold accumulations and strings persist at widened junctions in all four samples. Some junctions in the one-wall sample appear less bulky; different focus, lighting and viewing angles prevent a reliable quantitative ranking. Long straight strokes are comparatively regular. The five-notch coupon also has local orange surface irregularity near the left/bottom edge; its cause cannot be identified from the photograph.
conclusion: The tested wall-count changes did not eliminate the defect. This does not establish temperature, moisture, pressure advance, retraction or nozzle contact as the cause.

top_layer_review.method: Group consecutive model extrusion records by feature and spatial continuity within 0.002 mm, including arc subdivision. These are G-code runs, not a count of physical blobs or of retractions.
top_layer_review.interpretation: Replacing inner walls with concentric top fill does not remove the local paths at the junctions. A lower requested wall count did not produce fewer contiguous runs in this layer. This review does not establish which motion formed each photographed defect.

next_diagnostic_option: Review shared local paths before further gold-only tuning. A controlled comparison of the same tree with a different wall/fill strategy would test slicing sensitivity; physically observe when a raised loop first forms. No new print project generated by this feedback update.

blue_control.source: User photo followed by confirmation: Troquei o objeto para o azul com o perfil de azul.
blue_control.observation: Similar raised loops/accumulations recur at the widened tree junctions; long strokes remain comparatively regular.
blue_control.interpretation: The defect is not confined to the gold spool using its gold profile. Shared geometry, object/process settings, motion and the printer remain candidates; the result does not prove a geometry-only or slicer-only cause.

geometry_check_original_v5.limitations: These checks do not establish nozzle motion or physical extrusion quality and do not inspect the user-modified blue file.
